description: This is a test data script that constructs a list of 'ModelResponse' objects simulating streaming chat completion responses, involving various choices, deltas, and potential tool call structures.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a chunk of a chat completion response, containing metadata, choices, and possibly tool calls.

classes.name: StreamingChoices
classes.description: Represents a stream of choices within a chat response, including delta content and potential tool call instructions.

classes.name: Delta
classes.description: Contains the delta information for incremental streaming content, including content, role, and tool calls.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Defines a function call structure with arguments and name.

classes.name: ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall
classes.description: Represents a tool call within a streaming response, referencing a function with arguments and an identifier.
